DialogText:
Erected in commemoration of La Paix des Cinq Volées.

After generations of conflict, the five noble houses of Foréval set aside their quarrels and pledged themselves to peace. The principal bell of each house rang from its castle, five peals carried across one island.

This tower was raised at the Prairie d'Arpheuil so that their accord would not be forgotten. Its Cloche de la Concorde is the sixth bell: not the voice of a territory, but the voice of the peace between them.

During La Cérémonie des Cinq Maisons, the five castle bells and the Cloche de la Concorde ring together once more.

May their six voices remind every generation:

"Five houses, one island, and peace carried farther than any quarrel."
